sources.title: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Exact instruction checkpoint: 7.61B total, 6.53B non-embedding, Apache 2.0, text generation, and maximum context 131,072 with YaRN beyond 32,768.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen2ForCausalLM; 28 layers; hidden size 3584; 28 query and 4 KV heads; untied embeddings; max_position_embeddings 32768. No expert routing configuration.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct tokenizer configuration
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint template accepts tools, formats function calls and tool responses, and opens a direct assistant reply without a thinking-mode branch.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-LLM: Extending the boundary of LLMs
sources.evidence: Dated September 19, 2024; separately discusses Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, lists 7.61B total and 6.53B non-embedding for the 7B architecture, and describes structured JSON output and instruction following.

name.note: Display spelling represents the exact Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct checkpoint.

developer.note: Released by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud; baseline organization naming is acceptable.

family.note: Qwen2.5 belongs to the Qwen model family.

release_date.note: Official dated release announcement and detailed release post include this instruction model.

license.note: Exact card and 7B release table agree.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported total in billions, rounded to two decimals; 7B is the size label.

active_parameters_b.note: Dense model; no separately defined active-per-token count. The 6.53B non-embedding figure is not an active count.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer, consistent with the exact Qwen2ForCausalLM configuration.

context_window.note: Supported maximum; the shipped configuration defaults to 32,768. Longer input requires the documented YaRN scaling configuration.

modalities.note: Text causal language model. This configuration contains no vision or audio model.

reasoning.note: Scoped to a dedicated thinking/reasoning mode: released template has none. This does not mean the model lacks ordinary reasoning capabilities.

tool_call.note: Exact chat template explicitly handles tool definitions, assistant function calls and tool responses.

description.value: Open-weight 7.61B-parameter dense Qwen2.5 instruction model for text chat, structured output, and tool use
description.note: Replaces subjective size wording with the documented count and architecture; capability claims are supported.

patch.description: Open-weight 7.61B-parameter dense Qwen2.5 instruction model for text chat, structured output, and tool use
patch.notes: 7.61B is the developer-reported rounded total; 6.53B is non-embedding, not active parameters. Active count is not separately defined for this dense model. Maximum context is 131,072 with YaRN; the shipped configuration defaults to 32,768. Reasoning=false refers to absence of a dedicated thinking mode, not absence of general reasoning ability.

summary: Correct total parameters from 7B to the documented 7.61B and architecture from null to dense. Retain null active count. Confirm release date, license, text modalities and tool-call interface. Retain 131,072 maximum context with the necessary YaRN qualification. Reasoning=false is scoped to dedicated thinking-mode support.
